== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Set For Stun (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Set For Stun]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-set-for-stun/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_Set_For_Stun.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7ce4a08d03cb71535ae86c5c005d215bf8f393d83102820ef77be4ea62ea2ad3</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
